title: trace upstream-ref
description: UpstreamRefResolver output at <bundle-dir>/upstream-ref.json. Deterministically (or with LLM-assisted release-notes parsing validated against hard rules) identifies the qualifying upstream fix per §2a of SPEC.md, or records an ineligibility verdict. Patcher treats this document as given truth; Patcher never re-litigates eligibility.

target_version.description: The upstream version containing the fix. Required when eligibility.verdict == eligible.

fix_tier.description: Classification per §2a. Required when eligibility.verdict == eligible.

prefetch_hashes.description: Deterministically-acquired ground-truth hashes for the resolved upstream target. UpstreamRefResolver owns hash acquisition (e.g. nix-prefetch-url, gh release archive, locked vendor lockfile prefetch) and writes the values here BEFORE the Patcher is invoked. Patcher may emit a hash value in patch.diff ONLY if that exact value appears under prefetch_hashes[].value; any other hash value triggers refusal rule 8. List-shaped because the set of hash-bearing attributes varies by ecosystem (src.hash, vendorHash, cargoHash, npmDepsHash, pnpmDepsHash, yarnDepsHash, cargoSha256, …).

name.description: The Nix attribute name this hash belongs to (e.g. 'src.hash', 'vendorHash', 'cargoHash', 'npmDepsHash'). Patcher matches by exact name.

value.description: The hash value the Patcher is permitted to emit verbatim. Format follows the algorithm: SRI form for sha256/sha512 (e.g. 'sha256-...=') is the v0 default.

source.description: How the hash was acquired, for replay attribution.

url.description: The exact URL the hash was prefetched against, when applicable. Required for source=nix-prefetch-url and source=github-release-archive / gitlab-release-archive.

delta.description: Summary of what else changes between current_version and target_version. Required when eligibility.verdict == eligible so Patcher rationale can quote it.

crosses_large_delta_threshold.description: True if the configured threshold (v0 default: >10 transitive changes OR any new direct dep) is exceeded. If true and the bundle proceeds, kind MUST be human-review-required.

threshold_policy.description: Name of the threshold policy applied, for replay.

verdict_reason.description: Required for any verdict != eligible. Free text citing resolver rules.

human_review_trigger.description: Required when verdict == eligible-requires-human-review. Which rule forced human review.
